verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LocalAI loading quantized GGUF models: it runs a Q8_0-quantized phi-2 GGUF directly from Hugging Face, and its docs reference ggml/gguf models. So it handles at least one quantization format, but nothing documents the specific formats the story names. Missing for 10: explicit support for FP8, INT4, GPTQ, or AWQ checkpoints; documentation of which backends handle which quantization formats; hands-on or independent corroboration.
